question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

A can of worms

options.text: A plan kept back to be used later
A difficult person to deal with

solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. "A complicated situation or problem."

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let’s look at the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase: 
 
• The phrase 'A can of worms' means 'to create a complicated situation in which doing something to correct a problem leads to many more problems.'
 
• *Example*:
 
 
• *​The government is reluctant to change the old policy now because it doesn't want to open **a can of worms.***
 
 
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 4 'A complicated situation or problem,' which exactly resembles the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase.

 

Correct meaning:__ *A complicated situation or problem.*
